# Scouts BSA {-}

## What is it? {-}
:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="25%"}
<!-- ![](../include/img/xxx){fig-align="left" width=60%} -->
:::

::: {.column width="75%"}
[ScoutsBSA](https://www.scouting.org/programs/scouts-bsa/) is a youth program in grades 6 through 12, or ages 11 to 17 (both boys and girls in separate or co-ed troops depending on the structure) focused on character development, citizenship, leadership, and mental and physical fitness.

The ScoutsBSA program is run by adult volunteers to serve as mentors, teachers, and guides who support youth-led troop activities and community programs. There are many different volunteer positions, which require different training to make it easier to be effective in your chosen position.
:::

::::

View [training requirements (external link)](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Position-Trained-Requirements-Oct2025.pdf) for all positions.

## How do I access training?

- First, go to another Browser tab, log on to [https://my.scouting.org/](https://my.scouting.org/)
  - If you do not yet have an account, choose the `Create Account` button on the left side of the screen.
- Then come back here and click on the links below to directly go to that training module.

## Scoutmaster and Assistant Scoutmaster

  - [Scoutmaster Position Specific Training](https://training.scouting.org/learning-plans/1194)
  - [Hazardous Weather Training](https://training.scouting.org/courses/SCO_800) 
  - **Introduction to Outdoor Skills (IOLS)** 
    - In-Person Only
    - **Required to be FULLY POSITION TRAINED**
    - For the next offering, contact your council
